        assert select_words("Uncle sam", 3) == ["Uncle"]

        assert select_words("", 5) == []

        assert select_words("the quick brown fox", 10) == []

        assert select_words("ABC def", 3) == ["ABC"]
        assert select_words("ABC def", 2) == ["def"]

        """Test: Multiple words matching the criteria."""
        assert select_words("a b c d e", 1) == ["b", "c", "d"]

        """Test case where both numbers are below 2."""
        assert generate_integers(1, 1) == []

    def test_range_above_8(self):
        """Test case where both numbers are above 8."""
        assert generate_integers(9, 10) == []

    def test_single_even_number(self):
        """Test case where range contains exactly one even number."""
        assert generate_integers(3, 4) == [4]
        assert generate_integers(4, 3) == [4]

    def test_single_odd_number(self):
        """Test case where range contains exactly one odd number."""
        assert generate_integers(3, 3) == []
        assert generate_integers(5, 5) == []

    def test_range_with_only_odds(self):
        """Test case where range contains only odd numbers."""
        assert generate_integers(3, 5) == []
        assert generate_integers(5, 7) == []

        """Test case where range contains both odd and even numbers."""
        assert generate_integers(1, 5) == [2, 4]
        assert generate_integers(5, 1) == [2, 4]

        """Test case where lower bound is clamped to 2."""
        assert generate_integers(1, 8) == [2, 4, 6, 8]

        """Test case where a and b are the same."""
